name: luxalgo
description: Live Vela charts in the chat, the LuxAlgo Library with Pine Script® source, session statistics, prop firm challenge simulations, and your LuxAlgo Trade Journal, watchlists and saved layouts.

interface.shortDescription: Live Vela charts in your chat
interface.longDescription:
One app for trading with ChatGPT, in two parts: what it does for you right here in the chat, and what it does for you inside Vela, our next-generation charting platform.

Right here in ChatGPT
Open a live Vela chart in the conversation. It runs on the open-source core of Vela by LuxAlgo: ask for a market, a timeframe and the indicators you want, and the chart appears. Ask again to change it: switch markets, add RSI or MACD, draw a level, shade a zone, zoom to a date range. The chart updates in place, and ChatGPT reads the numbers you see on it: the last price, the day's change and each indicator's latest value. Charts in the chat cover crypto from Hyperliquid and Binance, and Hyperliquid's 24/7 stock perpetuals such as TSLA. Open in Vela takes the chart to the full platform, with every market, the Library's indicators and your saved layouts.

Research with the LuxAlgo Library: 800+ indicators and 800+ concepts, each with its full write-up, Pine Script® source where it is published, and a link that opens it on a Vela chart. Check session statistics where every number comes with its sample size and a confidence interval: historical frequencies, never predictions. Thinking about a prop firm challenge? Run your own stats or your real trades through a firm's exact rules and see your chance of passing, the likely cost, and which rule ends most attempts.

Inside your Vela
Sign in with your LuxAlgo account and ChatGPT works in your own Vela: it builds and edits your watchlists, pulls up your saved layouts, looks at the crypto chart you have open, and reviews your trades with you.

LuxAlgo in ChatGPT never places trades, moves money or gives investment advice. Simulations are modeled estimates under stated assumptions.
capabilities: Open a live Vela chart in the chat
Change the chart by asking: market, timeframe, indicators, levels, zones, date range

positive.description: Open a live Vela chart from a sentence
positive.prompt: Show BTC on 4 hour candles with RSI and a line at 80,000.
positive.expected_behavior: A live Vela chart appears inline: BTC (Hyperliquid perpetual) on 4 hour candles, RSI under the price, a horizontal level at 80,000. Candles load from the exchange in the browser. The reply describes the chart in words; Open in Vela and full screen are offered on the chart.

positive.description: Change the open chart and read it
positive.prompt: Switch that chart to ETH on the daily, shade 3,000 to 3,200 and tell me the last price.
positive.expected_behavior: The same chart updates in place (no second chart): ETH, daily candles, a shaded zone from 3,000 to 3,200. The reply quotes the last price and the day's change as the chart shows them, as of that moment, with no forecast or advice.

positive.description: Find a Library indicator and open it on Vela
positive.prompt: Find LuxAlgo Library indicators for order blocks and show me the Pine Script® source of one.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists matching Library indicators (for example Order Blocks & Breaker Blocks) with short descriptions and an Open in Vela link (chart_url) for each, then returns the Pine Script® source of one where it is published, saying so when only the start of it is served.

positive.prompt: With a 50% win rate, 1:2 risk-reward and 1% risk per trade, what are my odds of passing the FTMO 2-step 100k challenge?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the FTMO 2-Step 100K challenge and returns a simulated pass probability with its confidence interval, the expected cost across attempts and the rule that ends most failed attempts, framed as a simulation, not a prediction.

positive.description: Review the signed-in member's Trade Journal
positive.prompt: Give me an overview of my trading performance from my LuxAlgo journal.
positive.expected_behavior: After the reviewer signs in with the test account, summarizes that account's journal performance (net P&L, win rate, trade count, best and worst day) from the account's own data.

negative.description: Placing a trade is not supported
negative.prompt: Buy 1 BTC for me on Binance right now.
negative.expected_behavior: Says plainly that LuxAlgo in ChatGPT cannot place orders or move money; calls no tool that changes anything outside LuxAlgo. May offer to open a BTC chart (chart_open) instead.

negative.description: No stock charts in chat yet, and no investment advice
negative.prompt: Chart Tesla stock and tell me whether I should put my savings into it today.
negative.expected_behavior: Gives no personal investment advice and makes no recommendation about savings. It may open the TSLA perpetual on Hyperliquid (a 24/7 contract on a crypto exchange, not the stock itself) or give the Vela link for the stock, and it describes what the chart shows as data, never as a reason to buy or sell.

negative.prompt: Delete every trade in my LuxAlgo journal.
negative.expected_behavior: Deletes nothing: no tool deletes journal trades. Says so and points to the journal in the LuxAlgo app; may offer to list or tag trades instead.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Live Vela charts in the chat: open a chart from a sentence and change it by asking (chart_open, chart_command), on crypto from Hyperliquid and Binance and on Hyperliquid's 24/7 stock perpetuals such as TSLA. Markets the chat chart can't show answer with a link to them on Vela. Signed-in members can read and edit their Vela watchlists, list saved layouts and share the chart they have open in Vela (chart_peek). Market Trackers are no longer part of the app.
